title: School Access Grew, But Teacher Attention Still Collapses
hook: Literacy can rise while one teacher still faces a packed lecture hall.
closing: School access matters, but access without teacher time leaves students behind.
question: Which school gap surprised you?

segments.say: India has 127.5 million secondary pupils, making its school system enormous to manage.
Guinea-Bissau has 147.6 tertiary students per teacher, making individual attention scarce.
Education spending fell to 3.57 percent of national income, leaving expanding schools less room to improve.
Youth female literacy reached 92 percent, proving wider access still produced major gains.
Tanzania has 114 preschool pupils per teacher, showing the attention gap begins before primary school.
